Image Generation API, Pay Per Call For AI Agents — APIbase.pro apibase@prod ~ /srv/apibase/image-generation-intent APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Menu APIbase.pro Pricing Catalog Connect Integrator Dashboard Contact Privacy Terms Moderation Frameworks Partners GitHub X Image generation API with pay-per-call access for AI agents Stable Diffusion, behind the same endpoint as every other tool — no separate Stability AI account, no monthly plan. Live tool Tool Price What it does stability.generate $0.07 Generate images from text prompts via Stable Diffusion — style presets (anime, cinematic, pixel-art, photographic, and others), configurable aspect ratio, negative prompts. Returns a base64 PNG data URI directly in the response. Current price and full input schema ( prompt , negative_prompt , aspect_ratio , style_preset ): /api/v1/tools (filter with ?category=media ) or GET /api/v1/discover?intent=generate+image . How to call it curl -X POST https://apibase.pro/api/v1/tools/stability.generate/call \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_live_..." \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"params": {"prompt": "a lighthouse at sunset, cinematic", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}}' Response is delivered as a data URI — no separate download step, no expiring signed URL to fetch before it lapses. Not authenticated yet? /connect covers getting a key, or paying directly from a wallet with no key at all. What this doesn't claim One model family, one price point. If a task needs a different model or a bulk-generation workflow, that's a gap today, not something silently substituted — the tool call itself is the full extent of what's offered here.
